name: Anisotropic Texture Atlas Packing
definition: A method to pack surfel textures into a fixed-width atlas using anisotropic rectangular tiles sized according to the Nyquist rate of the hash grid, avoiding square padding on thin surfels.
summary: Anisotropic Texture Atlas Packing packs surfel textures into rectangular tiles sized by the Nyquist rate, reducing wasted memory and improving cache coherence compared to square padding.
